### UTC Date & Time

[August 13, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/aug-13-2026/2pm)

Today's facilitator: @nixorokish 

### Agenda

- Glamsterdam
  - [devnet-8](https://github.com/ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-8) (aka Platåberget) has been launched [ @barnabasbusa ]
    - Gas repricing numbers final? [ @jochem-brouwer ] [ [SLIDES](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31033765/Final.Gas.Repricing.results.pdf) ]
  - PFI [EIP-8261](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8261) (re: 200M gas limit: setting it in-client before fork risks premature increase) [ @barnabasbusa ]
  - history expiry: are clients ready for Glamsterdam? [ @kevaundray ]
- Hegotá
  - Timeline: PFI list should be final in 2 weeks, anything without a clear champion auto-DFI'd. Clients asked to come up with preference lists in 4 weeks (September 10th)
  - PFIs
    - PFI [EIP-7971](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7971): Hard Limits for Transient Storage [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine ]
    - PFI [EIP-8058](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8058): Contract Bytecode Deduplication Discount [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine ]
    - PFI [EIP-7609](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7609): Decrease base cost of TLOAD/TSTORE [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine ]
    - PFI [EIP-7973](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7973): Warm Account Write Metering [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine ]
    - PFI [EIP-8360](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12073): TCREATE Opcode [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine ]
    - PFI [EIP-7923](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7923): Linear, Page-Based Memory Costing [ @abc-123-c / @helkomine or @jochem-brouwer ] (slides below)
    - PFI [EIP-3298](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3298): Removal of refunds [ @jochem-brouwer ] (slides below)
    - PFI [EIP-5920](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5920): PAY opcode [ @jochem-brouwer ] [ [SLIDES](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31033615/PFI_.EIP-7923.EIP-5920.EIP-3928.pdf) ]
    - PFI [EIP-8358](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12058): Net Gas Metering for Account Changes [ @rakita ]
    - PFI [EIP-8374](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12128): Persist Warm Access Sets Across Reverts [ @rakita ]
    - PFI [EIP-8368](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8368): CPSB Recalibration for New Gas Limit [ @misilva73 ]
    - PFI [EIP-8077](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8077): eth/XX - announce transactions with nonce [ @cskiraly ]
    - PFI [EIP-8094](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8094): eth/vhash - Blob-Aware Mempool [ @cskiraly ]
    - PFI [EIP-8355](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12048) Precompiles for ML-DSA verification [ @shemnon ] [ [SLIDES](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1N9GLJNsPYF1Q_yXWQJnOKo0bADSZT2mSIZ-1pu1I-Ks/edit?slide=id.g3f6d86c03a1_0_0#slide=id.g3f6d86c03a1_0_0) ]
    - PFI [EIP-8372](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8372): Normalized state gas limit [ @anderselowsson ]
    - PFI [EIP-8375](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12130): eMBER, ePBS Mandatory Burn of Execution Rewards [ @benaadams ]
    - PFI [EIP-8219](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8219): Checked Arithmetic Opcodes [ @ritzdorf ]
  - Native AA (Frames CFI'd for Hegotá): Nethermind [now supports Frames](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2178#issuecomment-5223138367), breakout series restarting
    - Flagging comment by @chunter-cb for EVM incompatibility with Frames, preference for EIP-8130. Missed Hegotá PFI deadline, but specific AA direction still open per Frames CFI decision
- Misc

hi @abc-123-c - please make sure there's someone on the call who can actually speak out loud on behalf of each of these, they will need that in order to be merged, thank you!
No, it all belongs to the same person—@Helkomine. This is my secondary account. I had to create it due to an issue.

Want to add EIP-8358 Net Gas Metering for Account Changes https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12058 for PFI
And have one more smaller one: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12128/changes
I want to propose [EIP-8368: CPSB Recalibration for New Gas Limit](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12107) for Hegota

I would like to PFI two networking EIPs:
- [EIP-8077: eth/vhash - Blob-Aware Mempool](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8077)
- [EIO-8094: announce transactions with nonce](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8094)
I'd like to discuss ML-DSA precompiles for Hegotá: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12059 (EIP-8355)
I'd like to propose [EIP-8372: Normalized state gas limit](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12119) for inclusion in Hegotá.
I'd like to propose [EIP-8375: eMBER, ePBS Mandatory Burn of Execution Rewards](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12130) for inclusion in Hegotá.

Nethermind has reviewed [EIP-8141: Frame Transaction](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141), contributed to the specification to address concerns, completed an initial implementation, provided feedback from that work and ran a testnet.

Nethermind now supports EIP-8141 as a Hegota headliner.
I'd like to propose [EIP-8219: Checked Arithmetic Opcodes](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-8219.md) for inclusion in Hegotá.
I'd like to propose [EIP-8261](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8261) for glamsterdam.

Hi @abc-123-c / @Helkomine I remember you sending a message (but cannot find it again) that you wanted to present one of the EIPs I am PFI-ing also, I assume this is EIP-7923. Since you PFId it earlier could you present EIP-7923 tomorrow? Since the agenda is rather packed tomorrow I would not want to spend time tomorrow during the call to decide who presents it. Thanks! 😄 👍 

EDIT: I am at the call and will also present EIP-7923 (as already scheduled)
I'm sorry, but like you, I also cannot join this call.
Would like to triple check: Are all clients ready to expire 5.5(?) months of history for G*? Given the gas limit increase and 8037, it seems that nodes on 2TB might not have enough space.

I unfortunately can't make this call, so I'll request a slot on the next one! 

Wanted to flag that 8141 is a breaking protocol change to accounts (opcodes etc), and chains that don't hard-fork it in can't run it. Despite several deep evaluations across different teams, the EVM ecosystem has not converged on frames. Enshrining 8141 on L1 without that convergence risks large portions of EVM activity running an incompatible account standard, with wallets forced to target two incompatible models.

EIP-8130 is an alternative on this axis. It requires no EVM changes and no new opcodes, and the accounts are deployable on any EVM chain today. It supports (or can support) L1's long-term goals (censorship-resistant payments under FOCIL, privacy-pool self-payment, ZK aggregation, PQ, etc) and it provides shared wallet standards for things like key rotation, while staying performant. 

I intend to PFI 8130 for L1 in Hegóta and will schedule that on the next ACDE. At the breakout series we can do a more in-depth comparison between the two proposals. Looking forward to it!

@chunter-cb I definitely suggest that you make sure to attend the AA breakouts that are restarting if you can't make this ACDE call - clients are very close (maybe even on this ACDE) to deciding on whether or not Frames is the AA direction they want to go. The deadline to propose EIPs for Hegotá was on August 6th, so EIP-8130 cannot be proposed on its own. However, when developers moved EIP-8141 to "considered", it was with the caveat that there was disagreement about the specific AA implementation and that it would act as a placeholder for native AA, regardless of specific implementation
Will keep an eye for the AA breakouts. Any planned date yet?

[PFI_ EIP-7923, EIP-5920 EIP-3928.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31033615/PFI_.EIP-7923.EIP-5920.EIP-3928.pdf)

Just presented this on PFI-ing EIP-7923, EIP-3928, EIP-5920 for Hegotá. One correction for slide 3: the 512 bits should obviously be 256 bits. (32 bytes = 256 bits)

[Final Gas Repricing results.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31033765/Final.Gas.Repricing.results.pdf)

And presented this regarding the gas repricing results. Again, thanks to everyone involved 😄 👍

[EIP-8355_ML-DSA Precompiles.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31034776/EIP-8355_ML-DSA.Precompiles.pdf)

Precompiles presentation.

Slides for [EIP-8372: Normalized state gas limit](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/e/2PACX-1vTknCXZVwerqe0NUcqWNsZ4DeXLBHNQS-KwETEnphPzhelgE9tnI7jaSzRBdT2QrK2yuU05jyFnHDoa/pub?start=false&loop=false&delayms=5000)
